t: Scrubb blast off mould remover gel delivers targeted cleaning for stubborn mould and mildew on problem areas. The thick gel formula grips vertical and horizontal surfaces for longer contact time, breaking down deep stains on tiles, grout, shower seals and window frames. The built-in applicator brush reaches tight corners and seals for precise application with minimal waste. Suitable for kitchens, bathrooms, utility areas and exterior frames, this zero-VOC cleaner offers controlled results without overspray.
